nuggets.text: The Colonials are 2-0 for the first time since 2004.
The Colonials' win at Wagner was their first season-opening road win since 2003.
Galen Combs caught three touchdown passes and a career-high 104 yards in the Colonials' opener at Wagner.
Galen Combs had just two catches against West Virginia State, and both were 42-yard touchdowns.
The Colonials held Wagner to 97 total yards and 1-of-16 on third down in the opener.
Rapper Wale attended Robert Morris on a football scholarship.
Former New York Jets head coach Joe Walton was hired in 1993 to build the Colonials' program from scratch.
Under Joe Walton, the Colonials won NCAA I-AA non-scholarship national titles in 1999 and 2000.
Colonials coach Bernard Clark Jr. won national championships as a Miami player in 1987 and 1989.
Bernard Clark Jr. played for the Bengals, Seahawks and Cowboys, then in the Arena League with the Orlando Predators.
